say:0:1510606001:0.text: This whole valley is covered in some kind of webbing...
say:0:1510606001:0.source_cn: 山谷里布满了虫子的丝线……
say:0:1510606001:0.male: This whole valley is covered in some kind of webbing...
say:0:1510606001:0.female: This whole valley is covered in some kind of webbing...

say:1:1510606002:0.text: The closer we get to the God of Harvest, the more of these nests we'll find.
say:1:1510606002:0.source_cn: 越靠近丰饶神的所在，虫巢越多。
